why_observable_is_not_the_problem: The released tool_call.prompts questioner prompt explicitly requires the generated system field to contain the exact <tool_call>...</tool_call> solver-output contract, exact final one-tool-call request, and grounded parameter values.
The released tool_call.contracts.check_task_sample_contract implements these same checks and defines contract_valid=1 only when no contract error remains.

The released questioner reward path calls the same contract checks and sends only contract-valid samples to solver evaluation, so contract_valid is an author-native training/evaluation condition rather than an invented STRI label.
65/72 outputs parsed successfully, so the dominant failure is not parser/runtime collapse; it is low valid-task yield under the author-native contract.
why_no_automatic_repair_is_allowed: The frozen P0-A contract preregistered >=16 contract-valid samples per source before any representation-sensitivity statistic may update belief.
Lowering the threshold after observing 14/5/8 would be threshold shopping and would also leave sharply imbalanced low-resolution source distributions.
Adding generations after the frozen 24/source budget would be adaptive support rescue.
Switching backbone or using another model after this result would violate the single-backbone/no-rescue rule.
P0-B and P0-C both require P0-A GO, protocol-valid scientific evidence, and the exact raw SHA; they are therefore disabled.

author_release_asset_check.release_observation: The author repository provides training scripts that write questioner_vN checkpoints under STORAGE_PATH/models/.../global_step_*/actor/huggingface, but README and repository contents do not provide a reusable trained questioner checkpoint or generated questioner task bank with skill provenance.
author_release_asset_check.implication: There is no existing first-party asset that can replace the failed base-questioner substrate without changing the operationalization after outcome observation.
